delivery.commit_subject: SVC-RUNTIME-HARDENING enforce inbound JWT/RBAC/MFA and deployment-plane approval authority

handoffs.message: Hardening implementation complete. Three acceptance items + targeted tests delivered: (1) JWT/RBAC/MFA validation in services/runtime_auth_inbound.py applied to runtime-manager main.py and legacy services/control_plane/internal_api.py with HS256 verification, role bundles, and gated MFA enforcement; (2) legacy internal-API kill-switch path now flows through service.execute_kill_switch via _SharedKillSwitchProxy.dispatch in services/runtime-manager/internal_api_routes.py, deriving stable idempotency keys when callers do not supply one; (3) approve_deployment route calls governance ApprovalDecision API (review→decide) using the validated auth context and returns 503/404/400 cleanly when governance is unconfigured/empty/invalid; (4) 15 new tests in services/runtime-manager/test_runtime_hardening.py cover bearer/MFA denial, JWT signature/expiry, role denial, foundation idempotency replay, and governance integration. Full pytest sweep: services/runtime-manager + services/control_plane + services/control-plane/bff/test_command_executor + services/governance + services/deployment = 76 passed; docker compose config exit 0. New env knobs: PANTHEON_RUNTIME_AUTH_MODE, PANTHEON_RUNTIME_JWT_SECRET, PANTHEON_RUNTIME_JWT_ISSUER, PANTHEON_RUNTIME_JWT_AUDIENCE, PANTHEON_RUNTIME_MFA_REQUIRED, PANTHEON_GOVERNANCE_API_URL.
Auto-reassigned review from Gemini to Codex after repeated Gemini capacity/429: Capacity / rate limit failure

Review requested changes. See docs/reviews/2026-04-28-svc-runtime-hardening-codex-review.md: ApproveDeployment is not wired to PANTHEON_GOVERNANCE_APPROVAL_API_URL/default runtime-manager compose, forwards non-governance actor roles that real governance API rejects, and searches target_type=DeploymentPlan which governance cannot create. Targeted tests passed (69 passed), but real service-family approval authority path needs correction.

ApproveDeployment refactored to deployment-plane authority (POST /api/deployment/plans/{plan_id}/status). Governance target_type=DeploymentPlan lookup removed entirely (governance enum can never produce that target). Compose wires PANTHEON_DEPLOYMENT_API_URL and PANTHEON_GOVERNANCE_APPROVAL_API_URL into the runtime-manager service. New contract test (test_approve_deployment_calls_deployment_status_with_real_payload_shape) validates the wire body against the real services/deployment/models.UpdatePlanStatusRequest Pydantic schema, addressing the permissive-mock concern. ApproveDecision remains the separate command for governance ApprovalDecisions. 71 tests pass across the review-cited suite (runtime-manager hardening + internal_api_routes, BFF command_executor, governance API, service-family contract). Ready for re-review.

Codex re-review approved. ApproveDeployment now uses deployment-plane status authority, invalid governance DeploymentPlan lookup is gone, compose service URLs are wired, real deployment schema contract coverage exists, and reviewer-added JWT fallback hardening is covered. Owner may finalize to done.
